title: Chain of Sahih al-Bukhari 12
lines: How did this hadith reach you?
quote_en: That you feed people, and greet those you know and those you do not know.
ref: Sahih al-Bukhari 12 — chain as printed on the page
arabic: تطعم الطعام وتقرأ السلام على من عرفت ومن لم تعرف
translation_note: Names exactly as printed in the sanad on Shamela page 31. Do NOT add full names/dates (e.g. which 'al-Layth') unless you verify them in a rijal book.
yt_title: This Hadith Passed Through 6 Named People to Reach You
